title: One-Year Follow-up Safety Study in Subjects Previously Implanted With VC-01™
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to evaluate the long-term safety in subjects previously implanted with VC-01™ combination product.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Previous implantation of VC-01™ combination product with subsequent explantation of all VC-01 units.

Exclusion Criteria:

* There are no exclusion criteria for this trial.
study_population: All subjects who have been exposed to implanted VC-01™ in any ViaCyte clinical trial.
